cues.text: Teddy, watch my new magic trick! I learned it from a book!
Last time you burned my socks. Fine, but only one try.
Meow?! Peddy, I have a TAIL! And whiskers!
You look so cute! Can I keep you?
This is not funny! Turn me back right now!
Umm… I only read the first page of the book.
Woof! A cat! Come here, little kitty!
Peddy, help! The dog wants to chase me!
I just want to play! Woof woof!
Peddy, read the second page! FAST!
Finally. I'm me again. No more magic, ever.
Deal. Sorry, Teddy. Want some milk?
